You can receive Defender Experts Notifications from Defender Experts through the
following mediums:
The Microsoft Defender portal's Incidents
page
The Microsoft Defender portal's Alerts
page
OData alerting API and REST API
DeviceAlertEvents table in Advanced hunting
Your email if you configure an email notifications rule
You can filter your incidents and alerts if you want to only see the Defender Experts
Notifications among the many alerts. To do so:
1. On the navigation menu, go to Incidents & alerts > Incidents > select the
icon.
